author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
The machine parts stand that Adam has used in his shop for the past decade is in dire need of a rebuild--it's too wobbly and its wheels are literally falling apart. So to build a new stand for his rotary table and surfacing plates, Adam takes stock of one of his favorite materials to build sturdy shop infrastructure: 1-inch thick utility grade plywood. 

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
